A robot can walk and talk. Is it a living thing?
机器人会走路会说话,它是生物吗?
A robot is a non-living thing. It cannot grow or reproduce.
What 3 things do all living things need?
所有生物都需要哪三样东西?
Living things need water, food and air to survive.
What 3 things can all living things do?
所有生物都能做哪三件事?
Living things grow, respond to changes and reproduce.
You tap the tank. The fish swims away. What does this show?
你敲鱼缸,鱼游走了。这说明生物的什么特征?
The fish is a living thing. It responds to changes.
A seed does not move. Is it a living thing?
种子一动也不动,它是生物吗?
A seed is a living thing. It can grow into a young plant.
Why do we poke holes in the lid of a bug jar?
养虫子的罐子,盖子上为什么要戳洞?
Living things need air to survive.
Do plants need to eat lunch?
植物要吃午饭吗?
Plants make their own food when there is light.
Mould grows on old bread. Is mould a living thing?
旧面包上长了霉。霉是生物吗?
Mould is a living thing. It can grow and reproduce.
What do we call grouping things by their similarities?
把相似的东西分成一组,叫什么?
Classification is grouping things based on their similarities.
A plant grows towards the window. What does this show?
植物朝窗户的方向长。这说明什么?
The plant responds to changes by growing towards the light.
Why do we need water? Give one reason.
我们为什么需要水?说一个原因。
We need water to remove waste and carry out our daily activities.
A mimosa folds its leaves when touched. Which characteristic is this?
含羞草一碰就合上叶子。这是生物的哪个特征?
The mimosa responds to changes to protect itself from harm.
Why must living things reproduce?
生物为什么要繁殖?
The ability to reproduce ensures the survival of living things.
Name two ways animals reproduce.
说出动物繁殖的两种方式。
Some animals give birth to their young alive. Others lay eggs.
Name two ways plants reproduce.
说出植物繁殖的两种方式。
Some plants reproduce by seeds. Others reproduce by spores.
X grows, reproduces and needs air. Y only moves. Which is a living thing?
X 会长大、会繁殖、需要空气。Y 只会动。哪个是生物?
X is a living thing because it can grow and reproduce.
A penguin cannot fly. Is it a bird?
企鹅不会飞,它是鸟吗?
A penguin is a bird. It has feathers as its outer covering.
How many legs does an insect have?
昆虫有几条腿?
An insect has six legs, a pair of feelers and three body parts.
Is a spider an insect?
蜘蛛是昆虫吗?
A spider is not an insect because it has eight legs, not six.
A whale lives in the sea. Is it a fish?
鲸鱼住在海里,它是鱼吗?
A whale is a mammal. It gives birth to its young alive.
What covers a fish, a bird and a mammal?
鱼、鸟、哺乳动物的身体表面各是什么?
Fish have scales. Birds have feathers. Mammals have hair or fur.
Frog skin and snake skin: what is different?
青蛙和蛇的皮肤有什么不同?
A frog has moist skin but a snake has dry and scaly skin.
A tree has fruits but no flowers today. Is it a flowering plant?
一棵树有果实,今天没看到花。它是开花植物吗?
It is a flowering plant. The flowers develop into fruits.
What are the four main groups of living things?
生物分成哪四大类?
Living things can be classified into plants, animals, fungi and bacteria.
How does a fish breathe?
鱼怎样呼吸?
Fish breathe through their gills and have fins to swim.
Name two ways a frog can breathe.
青蛙可以用哪两种方式呼吸?
Amphibians can breathe through their moist skin and their lungs.
Is a starfish a fish?
海星是鱼吗?
A sea star is not a fish. It does not have scales or gills.
What can a mammal mother make for her young?
哺乳动物妈妈能为宝宝产生什么?
Female mammals produce milk for their young.
How do non-flowering plants reproduce?
不开花植物怎样繁殖?
Non-flowering plants do not bear flowers. They reproduce from spores.
Reptiles are cold-blooded. What does that mean?
爬行动物是冷血动物。这是什么意思?
The body temperature of a reptile changes with its environment.
P has spores and cannot make food. Q has feathers and lays eggs. What are they?
P 有孢子、不能制造食物。Q 有羽毛、会产卵。它们是什么?
P is a fungus because it has spores and cannot make its own food.
Is a mushroom a plant?
蘑菇是植物吗?
Fungi cannot make their own food.
How do fungi reproduce?
真菌怎样繁殖?
Fungi reproduce by spores.
What 2 things help mould grow fast?
哪两样东西让霉长得快?
Mould grows well when there is moisture and warmth.
Fresh bread or toast: which gets mouldy first?
新鲜面包和烤面包,哪个先发霉?
The fresh bread has more water, so mould grows faster on it.
Can you see bacteria with your eyes?
用眼睛能看到细菌吗?
Bacteria are tiny living things. We need a microscope to see them.
Are all bacteria bad for us?
所有细菌都是坏的吗?
Some bacteria are harmful, while others are useful to us.
Name a useful fungus. What does it do?
说出一种有用的真菌。它能做什么?
Yeast is a useful fungus. It is used to make the dough rise.
Name three examples of fungi.
说出三种真菌。
Mushrooms, yeast and mould are fungi.
How does a fungus get its food?
真菌怎样得到食物?
Fungi break down the object into simpler substances and absorb them as food.
Where are the spores of a mushroom found?
蘑菇的孢子在哪里?
The spores of a mushroom are found in the gills under the cap.
Why must we wash our hands before eating?
吃东西前为什么要洗手?
Harmful bacteria on our hands can enter our body and make us sick.
Name the three shapes of bacteria.
说出细菌的三种形状。
Bacteria can be rod-shaped, sphere-shaped or spiral-shaped.
Why should we not eat mouldy bread?
为什么不能吃发霉的面包?
Bread mould is a harmful fungus. Eating mouldy bread can make us sick.
How do useful bacteria in our body help us?
身体里有用的细菌怎样帮我们?
Useful bacteria in our body help us to break down food.
Mould test: toasted bread vs untoasted bread. Which variable is changed?
霉菌实验:烤过和没烤过的面包。改变的变量是什么?
The variable changed is whether the bread is toasted.
Why is a fish tank made of glass?
鱼缸为什么用玻璃做?
Glass is transparent, so we can see the fish clearly.
Why is a raincoat made of plastic?
雨衣为什么用塑料做?
Plastic is waterproof, so it keeps us dry in the rain.
A ruler bends but does not break. Is it strong or flexible?
尺子弯了但没断。这是坚固还是柔韧?
It is flexible. It can bend without breaking.
Which lets the most light pass through: A, B or C?
A、B、C 哪个让最多的光通过?
Material A is transparent. It allows most light to pass through.
Why is a towel made of cotton?
毛巾为什么用棉布做?
Cotton absorbs water, so the towel can dry our body.
A holds 5 weights. B breaks at 2 weights. Which is stronger?
A 能挂 5 个砝码,B 挂 2 个就断。哪个更坚固?
A is stronger. It can hold more weights before it breaks.
Wood and a metal spoon are put in water. What happens?
木头和金属汤匙放进水里,会怎样?
The wood floats on water but the metal spoon sinks in water.
Which material is best for an umbrella: A, B or C?
A、B、C 哪种材料最适合做雨伞?
Material C is waterproof, so it keeps the user dry.
Where does wood come from? What is glass made from?
木头从哪里来?玻璃用什么做?
Wood comes from trees. Glass is made from sand.
Wool, silk and cotton: where do they come from?
羊毛、丝、棉,各从哪里来?
Fabric can come from animals or plants.
What does 'waterproof' mean?
waterproof(防水)是什么意思?
A waterproof material does not absorb water at all.
A ceramic tile breaks when it is bent. Is it flexible or rigid?
瓷砖一弯就断。它是 flexible 还是 rigid?
Materials that break easily when bent are rigid.
Metal sinks. So why can a metal ship float?
金属会沉。那金属做的船为什么能浮?
The trapped air inside the ship helps it to float on water.
Why is a shopping trolley made of metal?
购物手推车为什么用金属做?
Metal is rigid, so the trolley can hold heavy groceries without bending.
For the lens of spectacles: A lets most light through, B lets none. Which one?
做眼镜片:A 让大部分光通过,B 完全不透光。选哪个?
Material A is transparent, so the user can see clearly through the lens.
What are the 3 stages of a flowering plant?
开花植物的生命周期有哪 3 个阶段?
The three stages are the seed, the young plant and the adult plant.
What does a seed need to germinate?
种子发芽(germinate)需要什么?
A seed needs water, air and a suitable temperature to germinate.
Can a seed start to grow in the dark?
种子在黑暗里能发芽吗?
A seed does not need light to germinate. It uses its stored food.
Does a fern grow from seeds?
蕨类是从种子长出来的吗?
A fern is a non-flowering plant. It reproduces by spores.
Which part grows out of a seed first?
种子最先长出哪个部分?
The root grows out of the seed first.
As a seedling grows, its seed leaves get smaller. Why?
幼苗长大,子叶却变小了。为什么?
The seed leaves become smaller because the stored food is used up.
Where are the seeds of a flowering plant?
开花植物的种子在哪里?
The seeds of a flowering plant are found in the fruits.
In the dark, which seedling lives longer: from a big seed or a small seed?
在黑暗里,大种子和小种子的幼苗,哪个活得久?
The big seed has more stored food, so its seedling lives longer.
Which stage of a plant bears flowers and fruits?
植物哪个阶段开花结果?
The adult plant bears flowers. The flowers develop into fruits.
What tool measures how tall a plant has grown?
用什么工具量植物长多高?
We can use a ruler to measure the height of the plant.
After the adult plant, what comes next in the cycle?
成株之后,下一个阶段是什么?
The adult plant produces seeds, and the cycle repeats.
A young plant gets no water for many days. What will happen?
幼苗很多天没有水。会怎样?
Plants need water to survive and to make food.
Height: week 1 is 2 cm, week 2 is 5 cm, week 3 is 9 cm. What can you conclude?
高度:第 1 周 2 cm,第 2 周 5 cm,第 3 周 9 cm。能得出什么结论?
As the number of weeks increases, the height of the plant increases.
How many stages are in a butterfly's life cycle?
蝴蝶的生命周期有几个阶段?
The stages are the egg, the larva, the pupa and the adult.
How many stages are in a frog's life cycle?
青蛙的生命周期有几个阶段?
The stages are the egg, the young and the adult.
Which stage does not eat at all?
哪个阶段完全不吃东西?
The pupa does not eat and does not look like the adult.
Which stage of a butterfly eats the most?
蝴蝶哪个阶段吃得最多?
The larva eats a lot and moults many times as it grows.
What is a young grasshopper called? Does it look like the adult?
蚱蜢的幼体叫什么?它像成虫吗?
The nymph looks like the adult but it does not have wings.
Where do mosquitoes lay their eggs?
蚊子在哪里产卵?
Mosquitoes lay their eggs in stagnant water.
Which stages of a mosquito live in water?
蚊子的哪些阶段住在水里?
The egg, the larva and the pupa of a mosquito live in water.
Which young looks like its parent: a chick or a tadpole?
小鸡和蝌蚪,哪个长得像爸妈?
The chick looks like the adult but the tadpole does not.
What is a young frog called? What is a young chicken called?
青蛙的幼体叫什么?鸡的幼体叫什么?
The young of a frog is called a tadpole.
What is moulting?
什么是蜕皮(moulting)?
A young insect sheds its outer skin as it grows. This is called moulting.
Why do frog eggs have a jelly-like covering?
青蛙卵为什么包着一层果冻?
The jelly-like covering protects the eggs and keeps them from drying out.
Frog and grasshopper life cycles: give one similarity.
青蛙和蚱蜢的生命周期:说一个相同点。
Both the frog and the grasshopper have three stages in their life cycles.
Why should we remove stagnant water at home?
为什么要清掉家里的积水?
Mosquitoes lay their eggs in stagnant water.
There are fewer plants for butterflies to lay eggs on. What happens next?
蝴蝶能产卵的植物变少了。接下来会怎样?
With fewer eggs laid, there will be fewer larvae, pupae and adult butterflies.
Which part of a magnet is the strongest?
磁铁哪个部分磁力最强?
A magnet has the strongest pull at its two poles.
Does a magnet attract all metals?
磁铁能吸所有金属吗?
Magnets attract magnetic materials such as iron and steel.
A north pole meets a south pole. Attract or repel?
N 极遇到 S 极,相吸还是相斥?
Unlike poles attract each other.
Two bars push each other away. What are they?
两根棒子互相推开。它们是什么?
An object is a magnet if it repels another magnet.
Bar A sticks to both ends of magnet B. Is A a magnet?
A 棒两头都吸住磁铁 B。A 是磁铁吗?
A is a magnetic object. It is attracted to both poles of the magnet.
A magnet hangs freely. Which way does it point?
自由悬挂的磁铁最后指向哪里?
A freely suspended magnet comes to rest in the North-South direction.
Ring magnets float on a stick. Why?
环形磁铁在棒子上浮起来。为什么?
The like poles of the ring magnets face each other, so they repel.
Can a magnet attract paper clips through glass?
隔着玻璃,磁铁能吸回形针吗?
Magnetic force can pass through non-magnetic materials such as glass.
What is a magnet usually made of?
磁铁通常用什么做?
A magnet is usually made of iron or steel.
Name the two poles of a magnet.
说出磁铁两个磁极的名字。
A magnet has two poles, a North pole and a South pole.
A north pole meets a north pole. What happens?
N 极遇到 N 极,会怎样?
Like poles repel each other.
Name three non-magnetic materials.
说出三种非磁性材料。
Wood, plastic and glass are non-magnetic materials.
'Magnets attract all metals.' True or false?
“磁铁能吸所有金属。”对还是错?
Aluminium and copper are metals but they are non-magnetic.
Which way does a compass needle point?
指南针的针指向哪里?
The compass needle always points in the North-South direction.
How can you find the poles of a magnet using steel clips?
怎样用回形针找出磁铁的磁极?
The poles of the magnet attract the most number of clips.
X is attracted to both poles. Y is repelled by one pole. Z does nothing. What are they?
X 两极都被吸。Y 被一个极推开。Z 没反应。它们是什么?
Y is a magnet because it repels another magnet.
How do you magnetise an iron nail using a magnet?
怎样用磁铁把铁钉磁化(magnetise)?
Stroke the iron nail many times with the same pole, in the same direction.
10 strokes or 30 strokes: which nail is the stronger magnet?
摩擦 10 次和 30 次,哪根钉子磁力更强?
As the number of strokes increases, the magnet becomes stronger.
How do you make an electromagnet stronger?
怎样让电磁铁更强?
Increase the number of batteries or the number of turns of wire.
You remove the battery from an electromagnet. What happens?
把电磁铁的电池拿走,会怎样?
The iron nail is no longer a magnet, so the steel clips fall off.
You stroke a copper rod 30 times. How many pins can it pick up?
把铜棒摩擦 30 次,它能吸起几根针?
Copper is a non-magnetic material. It cannot be made into a magnet.
Name 3 ways a magnet can lose its magnetism.
说出磁铁失去磁性的 3 种情况。
A magnet can lose its magnetism when it is heated, hammered or dropped.
Name one thing that uses a magnet.
说出一样用到磁铁的东西。
The magnetic strip keeps the refrigerator door closed.
You test if more batteries make an electromagnet stronger. What must be kept the same?
测试“电池越多电磁铁越强”,什么要保持不变?
Only one variable is changed. The other variables are kept the same.
What do we call a magnet made using electricity?
用电做出来的磁铁叫什么?
A magnet made by the electrical method is called an electromagnet.
How do you make an electromagnet?
怎样做电磁铁?
Coil a wire around an iron nail and connect the ends to a battery.
You use 1, 2, then 3 batteries and count the clips. What is measured?
用 1、2、3 个电池,数吸住的回形针。测量的变量是什么?
The variable measured is the number of steel clips attracted.
Why do scientists repeat an experiment?
科学家为什么要重复做实验?
The experiment is repeated to ensure that the results are reliable.
The type of nail AND the number of turns are both different. Is it a fair test?
钉子种类和线圈数都不一样。这是公平测试吗?
It is not a fair test because more than one variable was changed.
How does a maglev train float above the track?
磁浮列车怎样浮在轨道上?
The magnets on the train and the tracks repel each other.
How does a scrapyard crane pick out iron and steel?
废料场的起重机怎样挑出铁和钢?
The electromagnet attracts objects made of iron and steel.
What does the stem do?
茎有什么功能?
The stem keeps the plant upright and transports water, mineral salts and food.
What do leaves do?
叶子有什么功能?
The leaves absorb light to make food for the plant.
Do roots absorb food from the soil?
根从泥土里吸收食物吗?
Roots absorb water and mineral salts. The leaves make food.
Why does a plant with a weak stem climb up a stick?
茎很软的植物为什么要爬上支架?
It climbs higher to get enough light to make food.
A plant in a dark box dies. What is it missing?
黑箱里的植物死了。它缺什么?
Without light, the plant cannot make food, so it dies.
A plant with fewer leaves grows more slowly. Why?
叶子少的植物长得慢。为什么?
With fewer leaves, the plant makes less food, so it grows more slowly.
In a plant experiment, why is oil added on the water?
植物实验里,为什么在水面加一层油?
The layer of oil prevents the water from evaporating.
What are the tiny openings on a leaf for?
叶子上的小孔有什么用?
Gases move into and out of the leaf through the tiny openings.
A tree stem and a herb stem: what is different?
树的茎和香草的茎,有什么不同?
A tree has a woody stem but this herb has a non-woody stem.
A carrot is which part of the plant? What does it do?
胡萝卜是植物的哪个部分?它做什么?
A carrot is a storage root. It stores food made by the leaves.
Why are cactus leaves shaped like spines?
仙人掌的叶子为什么像刺?
The spine-like leaves of the cactus reduce water loss.
Which part of a cactus makes food?
仙人掌哪个部分制造食物?
The green stem of the cactus makes food.
A plant's roots are cut off. What will happen?
植物的根被切掉了。会怎样?
Without roots, the plant cannot absorb water and mineral salts.
Plant B has most of its leaves removed. After 2 weeks it is shorter than plant A. Why?
植物 B 被摘掉大部分叶子,两周后比 A 矮。为什么?
Plant B has fewer leaves to make food, so it grows less.
Where does food go after the mouth? Say the 5 parts in order.
食物从口进去后经过哪里?按顺序说出 5 个部位。
Food moves from the mouth to the gullet, stomach, small intestine and large intestine.
Where does digestion begin?
消化从哪里开始?
Digestion begins in the mouth and ends at the small intestine.
Does the gullet digest food?
食道会消化食物吗?
The gullet transports food from the mouth to the stomach.
Where is digested food absorbed into the blood?
消化好的食物在哪里被吸收进血液?
Digested food is absorbed into the blood in the small intestine.
What does the large intestine absorb?
大肠吸收什么?
The large intestine absorbs water from the undigested food.
Which system has the heart and blood vessels? What does it do?
心脏和血管属于哪个系统?它做什么?
The circulatory system carries digested food and oxygen to different parts of the body.
Name the three parts of the respiratory system.
说出呼吸系统的三个部分。
The respiratory system is involved in the exchange of gases.
Which system works with the skeleton to help us move?
哪个系统和骨骼一起让我们能动?
The muscular system works with the skeletal system to help the body move.
What does saliva do?
唾液有什么用?
Saliva softens the food and contains digestive juices to digest food.
What does the stomach do?
胃做什么?
The stomach produces digestive juices to digest the food further.
Where does digestion end?
消化在哪里结束?
Digestion ends at the small intestine.
Why should you not talk while swallowing?
为什么吞东西时不要讲话?
The food might enter the windpipe instead of the gullet and cause choking.
Is there more digested food in the stomach or in the small intestine?
胃里和小肠里,哪里消化好的食物比较多?
More food is digested as it moves from the stomach to the small intestine.
What is matter?
什么是物质?
Matter is anything that has mass and occupies space.
Is air matter?
空气是物质吗?
Air is matter because it has mass and occupies space.
Which is NOT matter: water, air or light?
水、空气、光,哪个不是物质?
Light is non-matter. It does not have mass and does not occupy space.
Solid, liquid, gas: which has a fixed shape?
固体、液体、气体,哪个有固定的形状?
A solid has a definite shape and a definite volume.
You pour 100 ml of juice into a wide bowl. What is the volume now?
把 100 ml 果汁倒进宽碗里,现在体积是多少?
A liquid has a definite volume but no definite shape.
Which can be compressed: a solid, a liquid or a gas?
固体、液体、气体,哪个可以被压缩?
A gas can be compressed. It has no definite volume.
You pump more air into a ball. Does its mass change?
给球再打一些气。它的质量会变吗?
Air has mass, so the mass of the ball increases.
What is mass? What is volume?
什么是质量?什么是体积?
Mass is the amount of matter. Volume is the amount of space occupied.
What do we use to measure mass? In what units?
用什么量质量?单位是什么?
Mass is measured with an electronic balance in grams or kilograms.
The balance shows 3 g with nothing on it. What should you do?
秤上没东西,却显示 3 g。该怎么办?
Press the 'Tare' button so that the reading is zero before measuring.
Which measures volume more accurately: a beaker or a measuring cylinder?
烧杯和量筒,哪个量体积更准?
A measuring cylinder measures volume more accurately than a beaker.
Where should your eye be when you read a measuring cylinder?
读量筒时,眼睛要放在哪里?
Take the reading from the bottom of the curved surface at eye level.
Is the Moon a source of light?
月亮是光源吗?
The Moon is not a source of light. It reflects light from the Sun.
Which of these is NOT a light source?
这几个里面哪个不是光源?
A source of light gives off its own light.
How do we see a book?
我们怎样看见一本书?
Light from the lamp is reflected from the book into our eyes.
Arrow A or arrow B: which shows how light travels?
箭头 A 还是 B,哪个是光的方向?
The reflected light from the book enters our eyes.
Can you see in a completely dark room?
在完全黑暗的房间里能看见东西吗?
We cannot see because no light enters our eyes.
You can see the flame only when the 3 holes line up. What does this show?
三个孔排成一直线才看得到烛光。这说明什么?
This shows that light travels in straight lines.
Is a mirror a source of light?
镜子是光源吗?
A mirror does not give off its own light. It reflects light.
Why is a light experiment done in a dark room?
光的实验为什么要在暗室里做?
This ensures that the only source of light is the torch.
What is a source of light?
什么是光源?
A source of light is an object that gives off its own light.
Name two natural sources of light.
说出两个天然光源。
The Sun and stars are natural sources of light.
Name two man-made sources of light.
说出两个人造光源。
Light bulbs and fireworks are man-made sources of light.
What is the main source of light on Earth?
地球上主要的光源是什么?
The Sun is the main source of light on the Earth.
How do we see a candle flame?
我们怎样看见烛火?
Light from the flame enters our eyes directly.
Name a living thing that gives off its own light.
说出一种自己会发光的生物。
Some living things, such as fireflies, give off their own light.
It is sunny, but you wear a blindfold. Why can't you see?
太阳很大,但你蒙着眼睛。为什么看不见?
For us to see, light must enter our eyes.
The Moon is not a source of light. How can we see it?
月亮不是光源。我们怎么能看见它?
Light from the Sun falls onto the Moon and is reflected into our eyes.
How is a shadow formed?
影子是怎样形成的?
Light travels in straight lines and cannot pass through the opaque object.
Does clear glass make a dark shadow?
透明玻璃会有很黑的影子吗?
A transparent object allows most light to pass through it.
When is your shadow the shortest?
一天里什么时候影子最短?
At noon, the Sun is directly above us, so our shadows are the shortest.
The tip of a cone faces the torch. What shape is its shadow?
圆锥的尖端对着手电筒。影子是什么形状?
The circular surface of the cone blocks the light, so the shadow is circular.
What is a shadow?
什么是影子?
A shadow is a dark area formed when an opaque object blocks light.
Which kind of object lets no light pass through?
哪一种物体完全不让光通过?
An opaque object does not allow any light to pass through it.
What do we call the surface on which a shadow is formed?
影子落在上面的那个面叫什么?
The surface on which a shadow is formed is called the screen.
You walk towards a street lamp, under it, and away. How does your shadow change?
你走向路灯,经过灯下,再走远。影子怎样变?
The shadow is the shortest when I am directly under the lamp.
You hold ice and your hand feels cold. Why?
手拿冰块觉得冷。为什么?
The hand loses heat to the ice, so its temperature decreases.
What do we use to measure temperature? What is the unit?
用什么量温度?单位是什么?
Temperature is a measure of how hot or cold an object is.
Why is a pot made of metal but its handle made of plastic?
锅为什么用金属,把手却用塑料?
Metal is a good conductor of heat. Plastic is a poor conductor of heat.
Which box keeps ice cream cold longer: metal or foam?
金属盒和泡沫盒,哪个让冰淇淋冷得更久?
Polystyrene is a poor conductor of heat, so the ice cream gains heat slowly.
A metal lid is stuck. Why does hot water help?
金属瓶盖打不开。为什么淋热水有用?
The metal lid gains heat from the hot water and expands.
You mix 80°C water and 20°C water. Can it become 90°C?
80°C 的水和 20°C 的水混合,会变成 90°C 吗?
The temperature of the mixture is between 20°C and 80°C.
What is heat?
热是什么?
Heat is a form of energy. It causes temperature to change.
An object gains heat. What happens to its temperature?
物体得到热。它的温度会怎样?
When an object gains heat, its temperature increases.
How do you read a laboratory thermometer correctly?
怎样正确读实验室温度计?
Immerse the bulb fully. Wait for the red liquid to stop moving before reading.
Which thermometer measures body temperature?
量体温用哪种温度计?
A digital thermometer is used to measure body temperature.
Four rods stand in hot water with wax on top. On which rod does the wax melt first?
四根棒子插在热水里,顶上有蜡。哪根的蜡先熔化?
Heat flows the fastest through metal. Metal is a good conductor of heat.
A hot metal ball cannot pass through the ring. After cooling, it can. Why?
热的金属球穿不过环,冷却后可以。为什么?
When the metal ball loses heat, it contracts.
Hot water and cold water are in contact. When does heat stop flowing?
热水和冷水接触。热什么时候停止流动?
There is no more heat flow when both reach the same temperature.
